step1_analysis.description: A very low transconductance (Gm) amplifier designed for very low frequency biomedical applications. It utilizes a modified four-quadrant multiplier architecture with current division to achieve a wide tuning range and large input voltage swing.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Transconductance Amplifier Architecture With Wide Tuning Range for Very Low Frequency Applications

DC Gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop differential voltage gain of the OTA.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = Gm * Rout. With very low Gm (~nA/V) and high Rout, gain is highly dependent on channel length modulation.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's reported 75 dB, though sky130 0.5um devices might have slightly different intrinsic gain.

Unity Gain Frequency (GBW).description: Frequency at which the open-loop gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = Gm / (2 * pi * C_load). For Gm = 1 nA/V and C_load = 180 pF, GBW ≈ 0.88 Hz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper targets very low frequency applications (~1 Hz). With the reported 180pF load, GBW will be in the low Hz range.

Phase Margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the dominant pole (output node) and non-dominant poles (internal nodes).
sky130_expected.reasoning: A stable OTA design typically targets a phase margin of at least 60 degrees.

Power Consumption.description: Total static power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With VDD = 1.8V and estimated total current of ~5-10 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low Gm implies low bias currents, leading to very low power consumption.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by the saturation voltage of the output transistors (VDD - 2*Vdsat).
sky130_expected.reasoning: With a 1.8V supply, the differential swing can theoretically approach 2*VDD, but is practically limited by Vdsat.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, GBW, phase margin, power consumption, and output swing of the OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for CMOS Transconductance Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u

XM1 VDD N14 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N7 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N7 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N9 N14 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N8 LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N5 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 N12 N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N4 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N2 N11 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N4 N12 N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N2 N8 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N3 N11 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N2 N3 N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM17 N0 N3 N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM18 N1 N2 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
Ibias N14 0 1u

* Input Common Mode and Differential
Vincm INCM 0 DC 0.9
Vind IN_DIFF 0 DC 0 AC 1
E1 N11 INCM IN_DIFF 0 0.5
E2 N12 INCM IN_DIFF 0 -0.5

* Output DC Stabilization (Weak CMFB to prevent railing)
VREF VREF 0 0.9
R1 N7 VREF 100T
R2 N5 VREF 100T

* Load Capacitance (from paper)
C1 N7 0 180p
C2 N5 0 180p

* Differential Output
Eout OUT_DIFF 0 N7 N5 1

.control
  * DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis for Gain, GBW, and Phase Margin
  ac dec 20 0.001 1k
  let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_DIFF))
  
  meas ac dc_gain MAX gain_db
  meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_gbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  print phase_at_gbw

  * DC Sweep for Output Swing
  dc Vind -0.5 0.5 0.01
  meas dc vout_max max v(OUT_DIFF)
  meas dc vout_min min v(OUT_DIFF)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
